notes.title: Go Rogue
notes.content:
[h1]Be Extra, Go Rogue[/h1]

This latest update adds 11 new screens to Rogue Mode adding way more variety to the gameplay. Rogue Mode (which can be purchased in the "Extra Shop") has now been refined as well. Many small quality-of-life improvements have been implemented. Most notably the addition of an upgrade system. After each completed screen you will be prompted with a choice of 3 random upgrades. These upgrades can include new guns, bombs, health, or some new exclusive upgrades like the [b]Metal Boots[/b] that allow you to survive spike traps or an upgrade that grants you a 5% chance of enemies dropping a heart. All these thanks to Ternox (go check out his games he's an excellent publisher and developer). 

The upgrade will hit consoles shortly in the upcoming days (weeks?)

[h1]More Fixes[/h1]

Several bug fixes in this update make the game more playable (and streamable). Now the "voice" option also controls the cutscenes volumes. In addition, the master volume now also affects the cut-scenes (where it previously didn't). Hopefully, this will allow you to have better control over your audio.

[h1]The Future[/h1]

In the future, I plan to add more improvements to the extra game modes to try and flesh them out a little better. Also, expect some achievements in the steam version that are different from the console versions. Some additional tutorialization is also planned for each weapon and mechanic. Some visual upgrades. And of course some additional story and levels. Please stay tuned.

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: New Update (pre release for streamers and reviewers)
notes.content:
[b]New Build includes easier to use grappling horn![/b]

Whenever you are in range of a hook that can be swung on a large indicator appears. This should relieve ambiguity with the grappling horn. There is also a better explanation of how to use the horn. I've noticed some people try to hold the button down to swing but holding the button down changes weapons. Tapping the button will automatically attach you to the nearest hook, tapping the button again will release you from the swing. Pressing forward and backward will move you in either direction. Holding down a direction will increase momentum. Up and Down will increase or decrease the size of the rope. You can use this to climb or decend.

In addition to some minor UI / UX things, the resolution has also been fixed. No more odd flickering in chapter 2.

Finally, I am giving away keys to streamers and reviewers so if you are interested in an early copy go to thestreetlevelhero.com

notes.title: First Steam Update
notes.content:
[h1]We are on STEAM baby! ...and this is my first update![/h1]

[b]Hi! I'm super8bitRafa a solo dev on my journey to releasing my first game (Unichrome).[/b]

Unichrome is a 4 year-long journey for me to understand the ins-and-outs of the indie game scene. The game is coming to both console and PC. Checkout my very high-budget announce trailer:
[previewyoutube=kDkVJ2hC4kw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The actual update:[/h1]

The first update comes with some obligatory bug fixes. The end of each level has a specific graphic now too. Loading back your save file works better now. The Extras are slightly better and play a bit smoother. New button prompts as well. Smoother and more readable text. And much much more!

In the future expect more extra modes and updates that improve the overall experience. Stay tuned and feel free to reach out on twitter or instagram @super8bitrafa and let me know what you think.
